name: Valid User Registration
expected: User account created with hashed password & candidate role

name: Duplicate Email Registration
expected: Database rejects duplicate email with E11000
actual: Duplicate email blocked by unique index

name: Invalid Email Validation
expected: Validation flags malformed email as invalid

name: Valid Login Authentication
expected: Password matches bcrypt hash and valid JWT is signed
actual: Password verified and JWT token generated

name: Invalid Password Rejection
expected: Bcrypt returns false for incorrect password

name: Logout & Session Cleanup
expected: Session storage clears authentication token and authUser
actual: Auth token removed from active session state

name: Protected Route Access Control
expected: Requests missing Bearer header receive 401 Unauthorized

name: Invalid JWT Verification
expected: Forged token triggers JsonWebTokenError / invalid signature

name: Candidate Role Restrictions
expected: Candidates restricted from posting jobs (403 Forbidden)
actual: Candidate role blocked from recruiter endpoints

name: Recruiter Role Authorization
expected: Recruiter role granted access to job management routes

name: Admin Role Authorization
expected: Admin access granted to /api/admin/* endpoints
actual: Admin permissions active across all governance routes

name: Job Creation by Recruiter
expected: Job stored in database linked to recruiter ID

name: Job Editing & Modification
expected: Job details updated successfully in database

name: Job Deletion Lifecycle
expected: Job document deleted permanently from MongoDB
actual: Job removed and null returned on findById

name: Job Text Search Execution
expected: Search query matches job titles/descriptions via MongoDB query

name: Multi-Criteria Job Filtering
expected: Filters query by type=Internship & location=Bengaluru

name: Job Application Submission
expected: Application recorded and confirmation notification dispatched

name: Duplicate Application Prevention
expected: Duplicate application detected and rejected with HTTP 409
actual: Duplicate application rejected safely by existing check

name: Application Status Update Lifecycle
expected: Status updated to Shortlisted and candidate notified
actual: Application status modified and status notification persisted

name: Resume Upload Security Validation
expected: Multer accepts valid PDFs and rejects non-PDFs & files > 5MB
actual: MIME, extension, and file size restrictions verified
